notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #7: Please meet Miyeong, Eunae & Narsha!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/5a242be4f2c44bb3b2fc01a5198b8f7b7a8b525b.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our seventh issue of "Inside The Coma"!

After escaping from The Coma, Youngho returns to school and, having forgotten about his horrifying experience, starts growing interested in girls, as adolescent boys do.

At Youngho's school, many girls who seem to be friends with him! Firstly, there's [b]Mina[/b] from Class C. Mina is also the protagonist of The Coma 2, and a childhood friend of Youngho's from the same neighborhood who he's been close to for a long time. They're in different classes on different floors, so their interactions have become less frequent, but they still walk to school together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/11015cd2d091b8b2f2a1b0de9998d6c4d970bf24.jpg[/img]

[b]Miyeong[/b] is a good student in her class, perhaps it's because she spends all her time studying. She takes her grades and achievements very seriously, studying at various tutoring academies until late at night. Although she is sometimes embarrassed by the boys who approach her, she is usually calm, intelligent, and even arrogant at times.

In Youngho's class is a girl from the United States, called [b]Narsha[/b]. She is very outgoing, sociable, and good-looking, which makes her popular with many of the boys. She even seems to have potential as a K-pop idol, but considering that idol wannabes usually start training in middle school, it might be a little too late. Will she win Youngho's heart with her bright smile and affection?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KVCWWsucS38

And we can't forget about [b]Eunae[/b]! She's very gentle, introverted, and compassionate. She's always kind to Youngho. However, she doesn't handle the stress of school and her parents' high expectations very well. If you like her, you'll need to give her a little more courage and energy.

Who will win Youngho as a boyfriend? It's all about your choices and focus!

Oh, but one more thing: this is a horror game, and you should be aware that there will be enough elements to interrupt your love story.

Talk to you again really soon!
Minho & Dvora Studio

notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #4: Please meet Youngho!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/1b95707abc1aedcb5b424741ad87987f38660eb4.jpg[/img]

Everything could be a spoiler!

But I will still give a brief introduction of Youngho, because this high school freshman is the protagonist of the last game, The Coma 1, as well as the protagonist of this game. To recap The Coma 1 without giving away any spoilers I'll just say this much: he's a student at Sehwa Private High School, and he's only been in high school for a few months. The Korean Education System usually enrolls new students in March and have their final exams around the end of June, so it's been about 3.5 months.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/728de113a4275a5bc1c456c91b702651117e396d.jpg[/img]

For some unforeseen reason, Youngho falls asleep during the exam (or maybe it's after?) and ends up in the mirror dimension "The Coma". There, he encounters monsters and ghosts ... and eventually has to escape the nightmare school, which is the story of The Coma 1, although a lot of it is left out ... He doesn't have any special powers, but his indomitable will and observation skills help him get through the crisis.

In this new game, we get to know Youngho's family history and background indirectly, which helps us understand how he has this personality and mindset. There are subtle differences between Youngho's personality in The Coma 1 and Youngho's personality in The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters. It can be said that he has grown a bit more, and the reason why is revealed in The Coma 2B: Catacomb. So, stay tuned!

notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #3: The Order of The Coma explained
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/eb180e8839718bcfcc0b53ea7e80a270f681d773.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our third issue of "Inside The Coma"!

[b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] is separate from the sequential flow of previous works. If The Coma 1 and 2 came out, shouldn't a third The Coma be coming out now? Not necessarily, because there are some important and mysterious gaps between the first and second that we want to fill.

[b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] needs to be a bridge between the first game and second one, but it also needs to be a game for both newcomers to the world of The Coma who have only seen it on YouTube, and players who have enjoyed the first two games and are looking for a new instalment.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/934a3d7a54549108af362d18d6dbcdc0c3c89963.png[/img]
 
[quote] We're often asked why there is [b]The Coma: Cutting Class[/b] and [b]The Coma: Recut[/b], and why [b]The Coma: Cutting Glass[/b] is no longer available. The short answer is that The Coma: Recut is an enhanced version of the same game. In 2017, we began to work on porting the game to consoles. This gave us the opportunity to revisit the project by adding some new features, polishing the graphics, and refining elements of the story. It was later released with this rebranded title.

We gave the game a darker, more menacing tone. A large part of what makes The Coma an intriguing setting is the mystery that surrounds the Shadow Realm and the unexplainable phenomenon visitors may experience within. Since we had a chance to revise the graphics, we embraced an eldritch horror aesthetic to better frame the world’s sinister atmosphere. It’s our love letter to H. P. Lovecraft and the Cthulhu mythos. Most importantly, it represents the actual game we wanted to deliver. [/quote] 

The game brings back the protagonist from the first game, Youngho. As you'll know if you've played [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b], the protagonist is a girl named Mina, who is neighbours and long-time friends with the protagonist of the first game. Their escape story is told in [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b], but it was not from Youngho's perspective, so a lot of things are left unexplained.
 
[b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] begins with both the normal and true ending of The Coma 1. Many people were curious about the true ending, which was included in the remastered version of The Coma 1. It was clear that Youngho had escaped from the world of The Coma! So it was the purpose of this game's introduction to deal with both different endings. The opening sequence is a bit old-school style, but if you remember your slow and boring high school life, you'll be able to spot the oddities.
 
Due to the chronological order, if you're wondering which game to play first between [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b] and The Coma 2B: Catacomb, I'd recommend playing [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b] first, as many of the things that you thought were disconnected or weird will be revealed in [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b]. If you decide you want to play [b]The Coma 2B: Catacomb[/b] first, feel free to do so; you'll be able to play [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b] from an omniscient writer's perspective then.

Talk to you again really soon!
Minho & Dvora Studio


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1781890/The_Coma_2B_Catacomb/

notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #2: Back when The Coma began
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/e304f8ecd13cfb645210a8e46c16e9aed9bd3379.jpg[/img]

Welcome to our second issue of "Inside The Coma"!

This time it's about how The Coma series began almost 10 years ago.

Surprisingly, The Coma series is already on its third instalment. ‘Surprisingly’ because back then I would never have dreamed what would come of our debut game. The Coma 1 has fairly classic graphics, but a lot of players love it for its own unique artwork and style, and many people still get a kick of playing it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/f1c7c5b0bfe2426ac12288769d4aaf8577cd0e70.png[/img]

The beauty of this game series, and I'm a little embarrassed to say this as a director, is that many people have said that this "horror" game doesn't trigger unpleasant emotions and fears so much that it makes you stop playing, but rather draws you into the story, painting a picture of overcoming your fears and overcoming adversity to reach the ending.

At the end of the game, instead of thinking, "Wow, this game was really scary", the players think, "Wow, the story of the main character was interesting". This narrative is all the more interesting because it starts with an episode of an ordinary high school student in a unique and exotic culture.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/83311e8789bf230b13bd6538f6823f569b2dd8e4.png[/img]

As you follow the story of the main character, who may be living in a completely different culture, you gain information and knowledge that you didn't know before, and you endure the fear and experience the process with him.

The game isn't scary enough to appear in your dreams, but it does send players into a panic in some situations. The traps are easy to overcome, and the controls aren't difficult. But when the killer appears and chases you when you least expect it, you'll find yourself making mistakes that you shouldn't, and you'll be gasping for breath over and over again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/da114cee0006172bb36437b2d40519e429e38725.png[/img]

Why are you suffering so much for a trap that you could have easily avoided? The constantly dark environment and physically limited left and right field of view keep you on your toes, even though the game is 2D and has a third-person perspective. The game is nowhere near as good as the first and second instalments, but it's laying the groundwork for the series to expand a bit more.

The series is very interesting to me, and it has great potential because it combines the society I live in, my own past experiences, and the stories I hear from the current young generation. I don't know how many more great stories I can come up with, but I'm racking my brain.

Talk to you again really soon!
Minho & Dvora Studio


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1781890/The_Coma_2B_Catacomb/

notes.title: 🔪 Inside The Coma #1: Meet The Coma-Developer Dvora Studio!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/4c5204a874242dfa4f05d564a3054cbacf1c84e8.jpg[/img]

Happy Friday, Ghost Vigilantes!

Before unleashing [b]The Coma 2B. Catacomb[/b] later this year, we want to tell you more about the game with the "Inside The Coma" update series. But not only about the game, but also about us: Dvora Studio - the team behind titles like Vambrace, Scarlet Hood and - of course - The Coma.

[b]Dvora Studio[/b] was founded on the 28th August 2015, but I spent one year working in cafes in order to make the first game in the Coma Series. The formal company name was [b]Devespresso Games[/b] (Dev + Espresso Coffee), as this was what shaped the first few years of my indie game development life. I changed the name to Dvora Studio later on, because it was easier to remember.

Back then, we struggled to secure a programmer who could actually build the game. I'm a graphic artist with a bunch of cool stories, but I need to have someone who actually create the games with me. Those seats were taken by two programmer friends, who were later replaced by my cousin, and eventually filled with three indie game programmers now.

To create the narrative stories and events, I requested custom modules and DB forms to shape the visuals of the games by myself for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/904380/Vambrace_Cold_Soul/]Vambrace: Cold Soul[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1045720/The_Coma_2_Vicious_Sisters/]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141120/Scarlet_Hood_and_the_Wicked_Wood/]Scarlet Hood and the Wicked Wood[/url]. It added a lot to my workload, but I think it was possible because I wasn't married with kids back then, because it was so rewarding to work day and night to get the game done and to share the story and the characters and the world with gamers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946659/604811b87f664547e29577a8816cc31ec99f4665.png[/img]
T. L. Riven and KYNO have been a huge part of that journey. They've kept my imagination and inspiration flowing and helped me stay on track to keep making games. The stories that T. L. Riven has built on top of my ideas have been amazing and exciting, and he's gone on to do some amazing things as a game writer and is now a game producer for another company. KYNO is now a brand new game designer, designing and creating sophisticated and highly playable games.

I’m grateful that the games we make have been described by many as having 'unique artwork, beautiful music, and immersive, detailed worlds', which has led to a lot of people who love and remember these game worlds (The Coma Series & Vambrace Saga), and it's a pleasure to work for them.

Now I'm married, and I'm a dad with two babies to look after. Obviously, I look at the world differently, I have a different sense of purpose, and making a game with those experiences adds a different depth than before. I want to continue to make games that people remember. I want to make games for as long as I have the energy.

There are currently six developers working at the company, including myself, and we're braving the unbearably hot Korean summer weather. I know a lot of people are surprised at how six people can produce two game projects, but it's actually happening. We have a lot of ideas in our heads, and we can't wait to show them off.

Talk to you again really soon!
Minho & Dvora Studio

notes.title: The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters is a Korean horror adventure about high school and demons
notes.content:
The Coma: Recut is a remastered version of a Korean indie horror adventure about a student at Sehwa High who's being pursued by a relentless psycho killer. Running, hiding, and piecing together the mystery of this horrific high school are at the core of the experience, as are "poisonous tentacles and clawing shadows," because that's just the kind of game it is. It holds a "very positive" overall user rating on Steam, where it was released in 2017; you may have had the chance to try it through a key giveaway we did early last year.

A sequel, The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters, will take the adventure out-of-doors and into the streets of the surrounding Sehwa District, where student Mina Park finds herself pursued by something "dark and sinister," and that also looks a lot like her teacher. Her hunter is not just some rando lunatic with a knife, though, but a demoness from "the shadow realm" who, for some reason, really, really wants to kill her.

Fortunately, Park is not without resources of her own: She can scavenge and craft items that will help her survive "deadly encounters and afflictions," and unlock tools and upgrades that will open up new areas in the district. Running and hiding is still at the top of the menu, though. Crafting is great but you're not going to put down a homicidal hellion named Dark Song with a stick and some rubber bands.

The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters debuted on Steam Early Access in November 2019, and like the first game has racked up a "very positive" overall user rating. The full release is set for January 28, and you can get a closer look at what it's all about at devespressogames.com.

Howdy Folks!

Version 0.2.5 is officially here! We hope you're as excited to jump into the next 3 chapters of the game as we are to share them. In addition to that content, we've also done extensive QOL work on the first 3 chapters and the game as a whole. We were able to accomplish this with the community's invaluable feedback. Please continue to share your opinions or any bugs you find [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/devespresso]through Discord[/url] [www.discord.gg/devespresso] or right here on the Steam Discussion boards. 

We have done multiple playthroughs where we don't encounter any significant issues. We still stumble across the odd bug or typo here and there though. Remember, the game is still in Early Access until January. So, you can expect to encounter a few hiccups. If you do, please report it and we'll patch it right away. IF you do encounter an issue, it will probably fall into one of these categories: 

[list][*] Minor graphical glitches
[*] Typos in the script
[*] Random bugs
[*] Aberrant or missing sound effects
[*] An AI that doesn't always function as intended
[*] Missing content (Bonus wallpapers, etc.)
[/list]

[*] The Butcher’s animations were improved.
[/list]

[h1]GAME BALANCE[/h1][list][*] Adjusted loot events based on player feedback.

[/list]

[h1]PATH[/h1][list][*] Invisible wall correction
[*] Dark Song/Butcher chase freeze bug fix.
[*] Barricaded doors fix.
[*] School structure was edited for story expansion. (Location & inner event fix)
[*] Fixed the 1F Right Wing Hallway of the school.
[*] Patrol Route updates & corrections.

[h1]GUI[/h1][list][*] Wight Burrows have a map-checker icon now.

notes.content:
Howdy y’all!

Tris here with another patch update. The theme for patch was “rebalancing.” Aside from that, we’ve also added some pretty cool new content into the mix. We hope everybody gets a kick out of it. Without further ado:
[list][*] The Butcher: We added a bloodlusted Butcher who will chase you throughout the Market before Song’s arrival.
[*] Manhwa Cutscenes: All new cutscenes were added and others were polished.
[*] Expanded School Quest: New drama unfolds between the teachers of Sehwa High.

[b]Inventory GUI:[/b]
Inventory GUI was updated. Now, you can only have ‘1’ mace canister at a time. However, it will not use up a slot of your inventory (like coins). The logic being that it’s small, but complicated enough to use that Mina wouldn’t know how to fumble around with 2 bottles in an emergency. 

Some dialogue directional boxes have been toward to wrong character. It fixed.


[b]Korean Localization Fix:[/b]
[list][*] 철물점 지하에 못상자가 있다는 말 -> 철물점 가게 안으로 바뀜.

[list][*] Double Click Function on the Note UI
[*] Double Click function on the Inventory and the vending machines
[*] Mina Mace SFX Fix
[*] From now on, Mina won’t stop walking when you drain her Stamina. She will instead walk slowly like Coma 1
[*] Gamma In-game Module Fix

[*] Market has one more hiding spot
[*] Speaker-phone sound volume Fix
[/list]

[b]Black or Grey Screen after the Logo:[/b]
We made a patch for it. If you still encounter this, please make sure ‘.Net 3.5’ or higher is installed.

[b]Ultimate Song:[/b]
When you are captured by Dark Song, there will be a short moment before the QTE begins.

As always, please continue to share your feedback on the game. It’s really helping a lot! Also, please drop by our official Discord server. We now have language specific channels, so you can chill out in your mother tongue!

notes.title: Early Access Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hey guys! [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b]’ Early Access launch is right around the corner and we’re super stoked that the community will soon be able to experience another night of terror at Sehwa High. This represents a momentous occasion for our team. We got our start in the gaming industry in 2015 with our first title, [b]The Coma: Cutting Class[/b]. Finishing that game was a unique challenge for us then.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GZdRoU8BikE
Almost everyone had second jobs and we worked on it late into the night with whatever free time we could muster. Since then, we’ve had the privilege of making [b]The Coma: Recut[/b] (a remastered version of Cutting Class) and, most recently, [b]Vambrace: Cold Soul[/b]. The Coma 2 is the first time we’ve ever released a follow-up to one of our stories. We’re excited to share the continuation of that journey with you now.

[b]But why Early Access? [/b]

Great question! This is the first time we’ve ever tried something like this. Our goal has always been to deliver the best experience possible to the players. That said, we want to create a window of opportunity for the community to get directly involved in the development process. We plan to run Early Access until the end of December and, during that time, we’ll be paying close attention to your feedback to make [b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b] the best it can be.

[b]What’s new?[/b]

[b]The Coma 2: Vicious Sisters[/b] expands the dark universe established by Cutting Class/Recut. Old questions will be answered and new mysteries revealed as you journey beyond the confines of the first game’s setting, Sehwa High, and into the surrounding district. As Mina Park, you’ll encounter a new cast of characters while being avoiding Dark Song. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35622596/0efde485d274fc5d24e67b7614a59637bf04aa3b.jpg[/img]

Evading her is more of a challenge this time around though; as Vicious Sister’s influence grows over a new domain, Dark Song’s strength will also increase. Furthermore, if you’re unprepared for unique survival encounters, you may take permanent battle-damage that will haunt you for the rest of the night. 

[b]Outro[/b]

There’s a lot more to discuss and we’re more than happy to answer your questions ranging from the game’s development, new features, and even lore questions. Please feel free to share your thoughts with us and we’ll address those in future community updates (like this). Also, make sure to join our Discord community so you can chat with us directly or wishlist the game if you like what you see!
